mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (event_id, event_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, #{status}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM outbox_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW()) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = NOW() + INTERVAL #{retryDelaySeconds} SECOND, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
